name: Immich
description: Photos from a self-hosted Immich server. Configure with the server URL and an API key (Account Settings → API Keys on your Immich instance). Widgets and wallpapers can request recent, random, or album photos without ever seeing the credentials.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('immich') talks to a self-hosted Immich photo server (configured by the user in Settings → Plugins → Immich → Configure). All methods return Promises. Methods: isConfigured() → {ok:true, configured:bool}. recent({count}) → {ok:true, assets:[{id, fileName, takenAt, type, duration}]} newest first. random({count}) → same shape but random pick. albums() → {ok:true, albums:[{id, name, assetCount, thumbnailAssetId}]}. album({id, count}) → {ok:true, name, assets:[...]}. search({query, count}) → {ok:true, assets:[...]} keyword search. thumbnail({assetId, size}) → {ok:true, dataUrl: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'} where size is 'thumbnail' (~300px) or 'preview' (~1080px). image({assetId}) → {ok:true, dataUrl: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'} full-res, can be many MB — prefer thumbnails. Always check {ok}: an unconfigured plugin returns {ok:false, error:'not configured'}. The plugin gracefully degrades when offline (caches the last successful recent() result via iappyx.storage).
